embed.title: !fort
embed.description: Alerts when pokestops, gyms or stations change: new ones, removals, renames, moves, new photos or descriptions.

fields.name: What to watch
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}fort pokestop`
`{{prefix}}fort gym`
`{{prefix}}fort station`
`{{prefix}}fort everything` — all three (same as naming none)
One kind per rule; add another rule for a second kind.

fields.name: Which changes
fields.value:
Name none to get every change, or pick:
`new` — added
`removal` — removed
`name` — renamed
`description` — description changed
`location` — moved
`photo` — photo changed
Example: `{{prefix}}fort pokestop new removal d:2000`

fields.name: Unnamed forts
fields.value: `include_empty` — also alert for forts with no name and no description (often newly found, can be noisy)

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:2000` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:2000` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:region_north` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
fields.value:
`template:2` — use another alert layout your admin has set up{{#if isDiscord}}
@mention users or roles in the command to ping them with each alert.{{/if}}

fields.name: Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}fort remove pokestop` — every pokestop rule
`{{prefix}}fort remove everything`
`{{prefix}}fort remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
